cold_viewer.who_to_root_for: Meera, because she’s being humiliated and then revealed to be the one who inherits the haveli
cold_viewer.stakes: Whether Meera can stay in the house and claim the haveli after Sharma ji’s will names her as the owner, against Riya’s rejection
cold_viewer.open_question: Is the lawyer telling the truth, and how will Riya react now that Meera is supposedly the heir?

ai_checks.cliffhanger_reason: The promo ends with Riya denying the will and the lawyer revealing that the haveli is in Meera’s name. The immediate question—whether Meera really owns the haveli and what happens to Riya after this revelation—remains unanswered at the cut because the show ends there.
ai_checks.spoiler_reason: The promo only reveals the episode’s central setup and a near-term twist about the will and ownership of the haveli. It does not expose a later-series hidden identity, death, or ending.
